capabilities: Generate infographic images from the active note's content
Generate and edit image prompts before rendering
Choose among six visual styles (infographic, poster, diagram, mind map, timeline, cartoon)
Embed the generated image at the top of the note and save it to an attachment folder
Retry failed generations automatically with exponential backoff
extras: The plugin is free but image and prompt generation use the user's own API keys and providers may charge usage fees. The README discloses that the active note's content is sent to the configured AI providers. Also installable via BRAT; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note's content into an AI-generated visual summary such as an infographic, mind map, or timeline.

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI API key

summary: AI plugin that generates knowledge posters (infographics) from the active note using Gemini, with optional prompt generation via OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI.
